doc.title: Epic Technical Specification: Foundation & Infrastructure
doc.snippet: Performance targets: NFR-P1 (dev server startup < 3 seconds), NFR-P2 (production build < 30 seconds for Epic 1), NFR-P3 (HMR < 1 second), NFR-P4 (initial bundle < 50KB JS gzipped). Build tools: Turbopack (dev), Webpack (prod).

doc.title: Epic Technical Specification: Foundation & Infrastructure
doc.snippet: Epic-Level AC #5: Development tooling ready - Development server runs without errors, TypeScript compiles with strict mode enabled, ESLint runs without configuration errors.

doc.title: Epic Technical Specification: Foundation & Infrastructure
doc.snippet: Integration tests for build workflow to ensure dev, build, start, and lint scripts work correctly across the toolchain.

doc.title: Architecture
doc.snippet: Build Tool: Turbopack (dev) / Webpack (prod) for fast HMR (< 1s) and optimized production builds. Linting: ESLint with Next.js config for code quality and React/Next.js best practices enforcement.

doc.title: Architecture
doc.snippet: Initial setup commands: npx create-next-app@latest will-it-rain --typescript --tailwind --eslint --app. Establishes Next.js 16 with App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, and ESLint.

doc.title: Epics
doc.section: Story 1.5: Set Up Development and Build Scripts
doc.snippet: Configure build scripts with npm/yarn scripts for dev, build, start, and lint. Development server must run with hot reload, production build must complete successfully and be servable locally, ESLint configured for Next.js and TypeScript.

doc.title: Story 1.4: Configure Basic PWA Manifest and Metadata
doc.snippet: ESLint configuration exists at eslint.config.mjs with scripts/ directory added to ignores. Validation completed: TypeScript compilation passes, ESLint passes with zero errors, production build successful.

artifact.reason: Contains all npm scripts to verify: dev, build, start, lint. Missing type-check script that needs to be added.
TypeScript strict mode is enabled (line 7: "strict": true) - validates AC #6 for code quality checks.
ESLint configuration using eslint-config-next for Next.js and TypeScript rules. Modified in Story 1.4 to ignore scripts/ directory.
Next.js configuration - currently minimal, serves as build configuration reference.

constraints.constraint: Must use Next.js 16 (not 14 or older) - verified in package.json at 16.0.1
TypeScript strict mode required - enforced in tsconfig.json with "strict": true
No `any` types allowed - ESLint should enforce @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any rule
Development server must use Turbopack for HMR < 1 second (Next.js 16 default)
Production build must use Webpack for optimized bundles (Next.js 16 default)
ESLint must use eslint-config-next for Next.js and React best practices
All scripts must be defined in package.json scripts section: dev, build, start, lint, type-check
Build performance targets: dev server startup < 3s, production build < 30s, HMR < 1s, bundle < 50KB gzipped
This is a validation story - focus is on verifying existing tooling, not implementing new features
README.md must document the complete development workflow for developers

interface.name: npm scripts
interface.signature: npm run dev - Start development server with Turbopack (localhost:3000) npm run build - Create production build with Webpack npm run start - Serve production build locally (localhost:3000) npm run lint - Run ESLint on all TypeScript/TSX files npm run type-check - Run TypeScript type checking without emitting files (tsc --noEmit)

interface.name: tsconfig.json compilerOptions
interface.signature: strict: true - Enables all strict type checking options noEmit: true - Type check only, no output files target: ES2017 - JavaScript version target jsx: react-jsx - JSX transform mode

interface.name: eslint configuration
interface.signature: eslint-config-next/core-web-vitals - Core Web Vitals rules eslint-config-next/typescript - TypeScript-specific rules globalIgnores: .next/, out/, build/, scripts/, next-env.d.ts

tests.standards: For Story 1.5 (Tooling Validation), no automated tests are required per Epic 1 tech spec. Manual validation is performed through script execution and verification checklists. All Epic 1 stories focus on foundation setup with manual validation only. Automated testing begins in Epic 5 (Quality Assurance and Polish). Testing approach: Execute each script (dev, build, start, lint, type-check) and verify successful completion with zero errors.
tests.locations: No test files for this story. Validation is manual through: - will-it-rain/package.json (script definitions) - Terminal output from script execution - Browser testing at localhost:3000 (dev and production modes) - Build output directory (.next/) - ESLint and TypeScript compiler output

ideas.idea: Verify package.json scripts: Check dev, build, start, lint exist. Add type-check script if missing. Document all scripts in README.md.
Validate dev server: Run npm run dev, verify Turbopack starts < 3s, test HMR by editing app/page.tsx, verify changes reflect < 1s.
Validate production build: Run npm run build, verify completion < 30s, check bundle sizes in output, verify no TypeScript errors.
Validate production serve: Run npm run start after build, verify app loads at localhost:3000, test all routes accessible.
Validate ESLint: Run npm run lint, verify it checks all TS/TSX files, confirm zero errors, verify eslint.config.mjs has Next.js rules.
Validate TypeScript: Run npm run type-check (or tsc --noEmit), verify strict mode enabled in tsconfig.json, confirm zero type errors.
Create comprehensive checklist: Document complete testing procedure, run all validation steps, capture evidence, update README.md, verify Epic 1 complete.
